extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants and institutional grant administrators preparing biosketches and Research & Related budgets
extracted.subtask_description: Filling NIH-format biographical sketches and completing Research & Related budget (sections A–K) and budget justification for a grant application (project and subaward/consortium). Includes personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs, indirects, and cumulative budgeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the prescribed sections for each person and keep the entire biosketch to five pages or fewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training entry fields
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List Institution and Location, Degree (if applicable), Completion Date MM/YYYY, and Field of Study for each entry; begin with baccalaureate and include postdoc/residency where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement content
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement — describe research focus and relevance to the proposal and responsibilities (e.g., supervision, oversight of aims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the individual's role on the project, describe their relevant expertise and commitment (effort/months), and explain how their background supports successful completion of the proposed aims. Include specific mention of which Aims they will oversee and collaboration relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publications directly relevant to the proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Publications directly relevant to this proposal: (list of citation entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide citations to publications that are directly relevant to the proposed work; these are distinct from a complete bibliography and should demonstrate direct relevance to the proposal aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors — list academic positions (with dates) and honors/awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include institutional appointments with date ranges and notable honors/awards (e.g., travel awards, fellowships) that demonstrate qualifications and recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contribution to Science — describe major contributions (thematic areas) and provide representative citations for each contribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each contribution, provide a short narrative explaining the importance and context, and list representative publications (a–c style examples were shown). This may include subpoints and representative co-author citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete published work location
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: [URL].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a link/URL to the full MyBibliography listing for the applicant so reviewers can access the complete publication record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Type selection and organization name
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET — Budget Type*: ● Project ❍ Subaward/Consortium. Enter name of Organization: [organization name].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select whether this form is for the prime project or a subaward/consortium and enter the official organization name for the entity responsible for this portion of the budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Period and start/end dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Start Date*: [MM-DD-YYYY] End Date*: [MM-DD-YYYY] — Budget Period: [number]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate calendar start and end dates for the budget period and identify the period number (1, 2, …).

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person budget fields
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Senior/Key Person — include Prefix, First Name, Middle, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role*, Base Salary, Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary($)*, Fringe Benefits($)*, Funds Requested($)*.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each senior/key person include identifying info, project role (e.g., PD/PI, Co-Investigator), base salary, effort expressed in months by appointment type, and compute requested salary and fringe benefits. Summarize total funds requested for all senior/key persons in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Personnel listing and fields
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Other Personnel — Number of Personnel, Project Role*, Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary($)*, Fringe Benefits*, Funds Requested($)* (for Postdoctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter counts and per-person effort in months and requested salary/fringe for each personnel category; total number and total funds must be computed for the budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total salary, wages and fringe (A+B)
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget {A-B} (Funds Requested) — Total Salary, Wages and Fringe Benefits (A+B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate senior/key person and other personnel salary and fringe benefit requests into the combined A+B total for direct personnel costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment description threshold and listing
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment Description — List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $ [threshold].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an itemized list of equipment requests that exceed the applicable per-item threshold (enter dollar amounts and justification in attached files). Total equipment funds requested should be reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel — 1. Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) 2. Foreign Travel Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide estimated funds for domestic and foreign travel separately and include justification (purpose, number of trips, participants) in budget justification attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs — 1. Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance 2. Stipends 3. Travel 4. Subsistence 5. Other; include Number of Participants/Trainees and Total Participant/Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For trainee/participant support, list each cost element and provide counts and totals, with supporting detail in the budget justification attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs categories (F)
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs — 1. Materials and Supplies 2. Publication Costs 3. Consultant Services 4. ADP/Computer Services 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees 7. Alterations and Renovations 8. Animal Costs 9. NGN Charge (Next Generation Network) 10. HS-TSC (Health Sciences Technology Services Charge) 11. Data Management and Sharing Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize and provide dollar amounts and explanation for each relevant category. Include any additional 'Other' line items as needed. Totals for Other Direct Costs must be computed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct costs aggregation (G)
rubrics_metrics.description: G. Direct Costs — Total Direct Costs (A thru F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum sections A through F to produce the total direct costs for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect costs rule and fields (H)
rubrics_metrics.description: H. Indirect Costs — Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%) Indirect Cost Base ($) Funds Requested ($)*.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the type of indirect cost base, the applicable indirect cost rate and base amount, and compute the funds requested for indirect costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect cost calculation basis and institutional F&A rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Indirect Costs — UC San Diego’s indirect costs are calculated based on Modified Total Direct Costs (MTDC) as defined in 2 CFR Part 200.68 using Facilities and Administration (F&A) rates approved by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use MTDC per 2 CFR Part 200.68. For UCSD the example F&A rates provided are: July 1, 2017–June 30, 2018: 56.0%; July 1, 2018–June 30, 2019: 57.0%; July 1, 2019–June 30, 2020: 57.5%; July 1, 2020–June 30, 2021: 57.5%; July 1, 2021, until amended: 58.0%. Cognizant federal agency contact information should be provided where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total direct and indirect costs (I)
rubrics_metrics.description: I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs — Funds Requested ($)* — Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum G and H to obtain the total institutional costs for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee (J) and Total Costs and Fee (K)
rubrics_metrics.description: J. Fee — Funds Requested ($)*. K. Total Costs and Fee — Funds Requested ($)* (I + J).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicable, include any fee and compute the overall total (sum of total direct/indirect and fee).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification attachment and required narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: L. Budget Justification* — File Name: Budget_Justification_[Institution]_.pdf. Provide narrative justification of personnel effort, materials, animals, subcontract costs, and other direct cost categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach a detailed budget justification explaining personnel roles and percent effort, recruitment plans, salary escalation (e.g., 'All salaries are adjusted +3% yearly up to NIH cap'), itemized materials and supplies, animal purchase and facility costs (with per-animal and duration calculations), subcontract details, NGN and HS-TSC charges, and fringe benefit calculations. Include supporting calculations and rationale for each requested amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: NGN and HS-TSC charges as direct costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Next Generation Network Charge (NGN) and Health Sciences Technology Service Charge (HS-TSC) — included as direct project costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These institution-specific IT and HSC charges are directly attributable, proportionally applied to personnel on the project, are not included in the campus F&A rate, and should be justified in the budget; auditors have determined allocable portions may be assigned to FTE on grant funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fringe benefits and salary escalation guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Fringe Benefits — calculated at rates currently in effect for the University of California. All salaries are adjusted +3% yearly up to NIH cap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the institution's current fringe benefit rate schedules to personnel salaries; include projected annual salary escalation assumptions in the budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward/subcontract reporting and differing institutional rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Subcontract/Subaward — include subaward organization name (e.g., Vanderbilt University), their budget type selection, personnel, other direct costs, and their indirect cost rate (example: Vanderbilt indirect cost rate 75.0%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each subaward include detailed budget pages (A–K) with the subrecipient's applicable indirect rates and cognizant federal agency contact information. Totals from subawards must be included in the prime applicant's budget where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative budget and section-level totals
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET — Cumulative Budget: include Section A (Senior/Key Person), Section B (Other Personnel), Section C (Equipment), Section D (Travel), Section E (Participant/Trainee Support Costs), Section F (Other Direct Costs), Section G (Direct Costs), Section H (Indirect Costs), I (Total Direct and Indirect), J (Fee), K (Total Costs and Fee).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a cumulative summary that reports totals for each section across the project and budget periods; ensure consistency between section detail pages and cumulative totals.
